focus_area: System Integration and Interoperability in Multi-Agent Systems

deliverable.title: Multi-Agent System Integration Analysis: 2024-2025 Breakthrough Report
deliverable.executive_summary: Comprehensive analysis of integration patterns, interoperability mechanisms, system compatibility frameworks, implementation complexity, and successful enterprise implementations in multi-agent systems from 2024-2025. Key finding: Protocol-oriented interoperability phase with standardized lightweight protocols (MCP, A2A, ACP, ANP) addressing previous limitations through dynamic discovery, secure communication, and decentralized collaboration.
